paragraphs.text: Personal technology.Always a work in progress.
I’m Victor, a software developer.I like looking closer — and turning complicated systems into things people can actually use.
I work where software meets the everyday reality of a business.
My foundation is Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and ERP: understanding requirements, designing solutions, implementing them, testing, deploying and supporting what comes next.
The interesting part is rarely just the code. It’s connecting the technical details to the people, processes and decisions around them.
I start by making the problem clear. What needs to happen? What already exists? What would make the change useful?
From there, I work through technical design and implementation, test the details, and stay connected through deployment and support.
Cross-team coordination is part of the work, not an afterthought.
Less mystery.More shared understanding.
Some of the things keeping me curious.
Raspberry Pi, homelab and server experiments. I enjoy exploring what I can run, connect and understand for myself.
AI-assisted work processes and web apps. I’m interested in where these tools can help with the work — and where careful human judgment still matters.
I’m open to conversations about contained software needs, especially work that fits remote, evening or asynchronous collaboration alongside my full-time role.
I’m also interested in senior and technical-lead opportunities.
